statement: For d,m≥2, the scheme-theoretic inverse image of the repeated-root polynomial discriminant Δ_(dm) is the reduced union Z_(2)∪Z_(1,1). Here Z_λ is the locus of polynomial spaces lying in an osculating Schubert variety of type λ at some t∈P1; each domino divisor is irreducible and surjects onto Δ_(dm).

answer.text: For d,m≥2, the scheme-theoretic inverse image of the repeated-root polynomial discriminant Δ_(dm) is the reduced union Z_(2)∪Z_(1,1). Here Z_λ is the locus of polynomial spaces lying in an osculating Schubert variety of type λ at some t∈P1; each domino divisor is irreducible and surjects onto Δ_(dm).

notes:
This is the preimage of the polynomial repeated-root discriminant, not the Wronski branch divisor. The conditions d,m≥2 ensure both domino partitions fit the rectangle. Migration: The result decomposes the inverse image of the polynomial repeated-root discriminant; this is distinct from the branch divisor of the Wronski map.
